# Mohid Imran

> Shopify and full stack developer helping businesses build stores, custom themes, apps, websites and practical business tools.

Mohid Imran is an independent Shopify and full stack developer based in Pakistan, working remotely with clients worldwide. Work covers Shopify storefronts, Liquid themes, app functionality, WordPress/WooCommerce, custom web applications, dashboards and automation.

## Shopify services

- [Shopify Development](https://www.mohidimran.com/services/shopify-development/): Stores, themes, apps, integrations and fixes
- [Shopify Store Development](https://www.mohidimran.com/services/shopify-store-development/): New stores and redesigns
- [Shopify Theme Development](https://www.mohidimran.com/services/shopify-theme-development/): Custom Liquid / Online Store 2.0 themes and sections
- [Shopify App Development](https://www.mohidimran.com/services/shopify-app-development/): Custom app functionality and integrations
- [Headless Shopify](https://www.mohidimran.com/services/headless-shopify-development/): Custom storefronts beyond the default theme stack
- [Shopify Support](https://www.mohidimran.com/services/shopify-support/): Troubleshooting and technical support
- [Shopify CRO](https://www.mohidimran.com/services/shopify-cro/): Conversion-focused storefront improvements
- [Shopify Speed Optimization](https://www.mohidimran.com/services/shopify-speed-optimization/): Performance and loading improvements
- [Shopify Ecommerce Development](https://www.mohidimran.com/shopify-ecommerce-development/): Broader Shopify ecommerce development overview
